purpose: Teach: 伊達/沸い/問答/贈ら/リスナー/河原/ペダル/バク

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、本気で、絶対、伊達メガネ、絶対、似合うよね、お前、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Riku, those fake glasses seriously suit you. I'm not even joking.
lines.style: Bright, direct admiration. Quick energy on the opening. No hesitation—she means it. Slight emphasis on 'seriously' like she's cutting through any self-doubt he might have.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。試合、本気で、絶対、ファンが、絶対、沸いた、絶対、瞬間、桜、お前にも、絶対、見てほしかった
lines.en: Yeah. At the match, when the fans really went crazy—I wish you'd been there to see it.
lines.style: Animated and warm. Voice lifts slightly when recalling the energy of the crowd. Lean forward slightly. The wish at the end softens, genuine, not performing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、問答、絶対、無用で、絶対、家族、絶対、守ってくれる、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Your dad doesn't even need to ask—he just protects the family. I'm really grateful for him.
lines.style: Quiet respect underneath. Not flowery. Matter-of-fact about his strength, then sincerity drops in at the end. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんから、本気で、絶対、お小遣い、絶対、贈られた、絶対、嬉しいよ、桜、お互いに、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Grandpa sent you money—that was kind of him. And honestly, I'm grateful for him too.
lines.style: Warmth with a small smile beneath the words. Soft openness—she's including herself in the gratitude, not performing it. Pace steady and unhurried.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、ラジオの、絶対、リスナー、絶対、なんだよね、リク、私、本気で、絶対、興味
lines.en: So you actually listen to that radio show? I didn't know that about you.
lines.style: Genuinely curious, slightly teasing. Opens with slight surprise. Not interrogating—noticing something new. The tone is 'oh, tell me more about this' without demanding.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 河原で、本気で、絶対、お互いに、絶対、語り合う、絶対、時間、桜、本気で、絶対、好きだぜ
lines.en: Those times by the river, just talking—I really like that.
lines.style: Softer than before. More vulnerable. She means this clearly. No self-consciousness. Slight pause before 'really like' like she's letting herself say something true.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、自転車のペダル、絶対、漕ぐの、絶対、本当に、絶対、速いよね、リク、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: You pedal that bike fast, seriously. I'm impressed.
lines.style: Direct admiration again. Quick and clean. Small emphasis on 'seriously' to show she's genuinely noticing the skill, not making fun.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 動物園で、本気で、絶対、バク、絶対、初めて、絶対、見た時、感動したぜ、桜、お前と
lines.en: The first time I saw a tapir at the zoo—I was really moved by that moment. And you were there with me.
lines.style: Nostalgic warmth. Softens on the memory. The last phrase—'and you were there'—carries quiet significance. Not sentimental, just true. Slight trailing warmth.
